# EUTOOM — Quanzhou Guolan Trading Co., Ltd.

Bathroom and kitchen hardware manufacturer and exporter based in China. EUTOOM is the export brand of Quanzhou Guolan Trading Co., Ltd.

## Company
- Legal name: Quanzhou Guolan Trading Co., Ltd.
- Brand: EUTOOM
- Founded: 2006
- Business type: Manufacturer / Export trader (OEM & ODM)
- Factories: Two own factories — Wenzhou (Zhejiang, operating since 2006) and Quanzhou (Fujian, operating since 2019)
- HQ address: No. 1111 Maosheng Road, Meilin Street, Nan'an City, Fujian, China
- Website: https://eutoom.com/
- Manufacturing: Two modern factories (Wenzhou & Quanzhou) equipped with high-precision CNC machinery and automated assembly lines. Real-shot visuals of the facility and production process are featured on the About page.
- Email: eutoom888@Outlook.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +86 137 9925 9581

## What we make
EUTOOM designs, manufactures and exports bathroom and kitchen hardware:
- Kitchen faucets — pull-out, gooseneck, high-arc commercial spring taps, wall-mounted (model series 83xx / 84xx)
- Basin mixers — hot & cold, pull-out, 360° swivel, waterfall-design (model series 80xx / 81xx / 86xx)
- Shower systems — rain sets, thermostatic, LED digital, concealed, simple sets (model series 70xx / 71xx)
- Smart sensor faucets — infrared automatic touch-free (model series 30xx)
- Valves, drains & scuppers — angle valves, bidet sprays, flush valves, hose pipes, floor drains (model series 60xx / 63xx / 65xx / 66xx)
- Bathroom accessories — 6-piece coordinated sets (series 100 / 200 / 300 / 501 / 700 / 801 / 900)
- Toilets & vanities — a dedicated sanitary-ware range currently being finalized for launch

## Finishes
Polished chrome (A), matte black (B), gold / brass (C), gunmetal / brushed grey (E), and two-tone black-gold (BC) and chrome-gold (CH).

## Buyer services
- OEM / ODM and private-label manufacturing are supported
- Sample arrangements available for most catalog models
- Custom tooling and branding artwork on request
- Export documents and consolidation for container shipments

## Markets
Exports to Europe, North America, South America, Africa, the Middle East, Central Asia and Southeast Asia, with a focus on North America and the Middle East.
